description: This file implements the ADOdb PostgreSQL driver, which is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer for PHP. It provides the specific implementation details for connecting and interacting with PostgreSQL databases within the ADOdb framework.

classes.name: ADOdb_Postgres_Driver
classes.description: Class responsible for PostgreSQL-specific database operations within ADOdb.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a given SQL query on the PostgreSQL database.
